_readme: Care-gap recommendations. When a note mentions a diagnosis (name or alias, whole phrase, case-insensitive) CareLoop checks each expected_item against the cards saved from that note and flags the ones nothing covers. Edit freely; the backend reloads this file on restart. card_type must be one of: medication, test, referral, next_visit, general_task.
